evaluator: E9 – Claude Sonnet 5.5, re-evaluation of E5's findings on the fixed build, persona: microscopy core-facility manager who trains biologists on Fiji; judges novice time-to-productivity and irreversible-mistake risk
method: One headless Google Chrome 156 (channel chrome, swiftshader flags, 1440x900) started on a private CDP port with a throw-away profile in eval_e9/, driven from Playwright (connect_over_cdp, e2e-venv python) against http://127.0.0.1:8766 in several short scripts; browser killed at the end and no process left. Clean start: File > Close All > 'Close without saving' (3 images incl. a modified one removed), Results had 2 rows, ROI Manager empty; the welcome screen then showed an empty session. Re-walked each E5 problem with the same control/sequence: palette queries, Image > Lookup Tables menu, Display min/max inputs (Cytoplasm max 50, Spots min 5000), Analyze Particles with and without threshold (DAPI hidden), ROI Manager/Results across images, Gaussian Blur plane/stack, History, recorder via GET /api/recorder with the page's own client id, palette error commands without selection, threshold persistence/reload/split view/light theme, New Image 20000x20000 32-bit (cancelled at the confirmation), Tracks wizard on a 128x128x20 noise movie, Preferences, '[' script-editor focus trap, F10 menubar, DOM audit (names, target sizes, tab order, contrast), narrow viewports 900x650 and 760x600, help overlay, Workflows and 3-D view. Also checked modified-image close, rectangle + Measure, Z Project, Apply Display Range sheet. Not tested: 'Apply recorded macro to folder', real file open/save dialogs, JavaScript/IJM replay of recorded lines, colour picker, composite-mode/dropdown LUT recording separately, screen-reader output. Clean-up: Close All, ROI Manager and Results cleared with their confirmations, leftover 'Particle Summary' table removed via the scripting API, server state verified empty (no images, 0 ROIs, 0 rows, no thresholds). Images I viewed with the Read tool are screenshots only and nothing remains open in the app. docs/USABILITY.md, other evaluators' files and source code not read.

reassessment.evidence: Image > Lookup Tables now lists the ImageJ LUTs by name (Grays, Red, ... Fire, Ice, Spectrum, 3-3-2 RGB, Red/Green, HiLo) plus Fiji / Perceptual (matplotlib) / Labels submenus (06_lut_menu.png). Clicking Fire set the DAPI channel LUT to Fire (state lut='Fire', 07_fire.png). Palette 'fire' -> 'LUT: Fire' first, 'viridis' -> 'LUT: Viridis' first (03_pal_fire.png, 03_pal_viridis.png).
reassessment.comment: Menu click acts on the current channel only; the recorder line colour.lut ... all_channels=False does not name the channel (see E5-7).

reassessment.evidence: Palette 'apply lut' now lists 'Apply Display Range to Pixels (Apply LUT)' (Image/Lookup Tables) and 'Apply Display Range to Pixels (B&C Apply)' (Image/Adjust; description starts 'DESTRUCTIVE: bake ...... To only change the colour map use Set LUT'), plus 'Set LUT' described as 'display only, the pixel values stay unchanged' (42_pal_apply_lut.png, 42_pal_bake.png). Import/Export LUT are separate names. Running the B&C Apply command opens a sheet headed with the DESTRUCTIVE text and an 'All channels' option (43_apply_range.png).
reassessment.comment: Two baking commands remain (Apply LUT / B&C Apply) but both are honestly named and no longer collide with the harmless display-only command. The sheet's 'All channels' label wraps awkwardly.

reassessment.evidence: 'fire' -> first row 'LUT: Fire'; 'Fire LUT' -> 'LUT: Fire'; 'clahee' (typo) -> 'CLAHE (Local Contrast)' first; 'gausian blur' -> 'Gaussian Blur' first; 'watershed', 'scale bar', 'z project' all put the obvious command first (03_pal_fire.png, 03_pal_clahee.png, e9 palette runs).
reassessment.comment: Weak matches are still listed after the good ones ('Proxy Settings…' third for 'fire'); 'threshhold' ranks 'Apply Threshold → Mask' above Threshold; 'fiji lut ice' returns only web-search rows.

reassessment.evidence: Palette 'Open Sample' -> 'Open Sample' first, 'Open ImageJ Sample…' second (03_pal_Open_Sample.png). Opened sample is named 'synthetic_cells.tif' with no '-1' suffix (state names, 05_synth.png). The Open Sample sheet lists the 11 bundled samples.
reassessment.comment: 'sample' alone still ranks 'Open ImageJ Sample…' above 'Open Sample'; harmless now.

reassessment.evidence: Analyze Particles on an unthresholded image: the error is now an inline, persistent red box inside the sheet (no toast on the Cancel button) with two buttons 'Auto-threshold and run' and 'Open the Threshold panel' (12_ap_nothresh.png). It stayed after 8 s. 'Auto-threshold and run' gave '41 particles'; recorder line has auto_threshold=True, channel=1 (13_ap_autorun.png). The Threshold section now says 'Channel 1 · DAPI is thresholded (the current channel – switch with the channel chips below the image)' and, with DAPI hidden, shows 'This channel is hidden in the composite: the red overlay marks pixels you cannot see.' with a 'Show channel 1' button (10_threshold_open.png).
reassessment.comment: The sheet's own error and the '41 particles' toast do not name the channel that was auto-thresholded (here the hidden DAPI); the Threshold panel does.

reassessment.evidence: Typed Cytoplasm max 50 with min 126 + Enter: state unchanged (126/947), inline red message 'must be above the min…' under the field (08_maxlessthanmin.png). Spots min 5000 > max 1785: state unchanged, message 'must be below the maximum (1785)' (09_minabovemax.png). On Tab-away the field reverts to the real value (171) and the message disappears (44 test).
reassessment.comment: The message is clipped / overlapped by the next row and the row layout shifts (Auto/Reset/Inv and the max box are pushed to the edge) while the error shows – cosmetic (E9-1).

reassessment.evidence: Recorder now logs display edits with the image named: lumen.display("synthetic_cells.tif", channel=2, max=500), channel=3 min=200, channel=1 visible=False/True; LUT change as lumen.run("color.lut", lut='Fire', all_channels=False); image switches as lumen.select("synthetic_cells.tif"); analyze.particles now carries channel=1; analyze.measure carries the rectangle as roi={...} (GET /api/recorder, e9_s35 output; Script & Recorder panel 32_bracket.png). Also offers -> Python / -> JavaScript / -> IJM and Clear.
reassessment.comment: Still one global session-wide log (no per-image log, no start/stop, only Clear); color.lut does not say which channel or image; I did not test composite-mode or the inspector LUT dropdown separately. Hidden-channel state needs a note in the IJM export (the export warns about it).

reassessment.evidence: History now shows parameters beside the command (17_history.png): after Gaussian sigma=2 (scope current plane) and sigma=3 (entire stack) it lists 'Gaussian Blur scope=plane' and 'Gaussian Blur sigma=3.0'. Display edits (LUT, min/max, visibility) still do not enter History and Undo stays disabled after them (Undo button disabled=True after the Fire / max / min / hide sequence, e9_s12 output; History on synthetic_cells reads 'No changes yet').
reassessment.comment: History shows only non-default parameters, so row 1 hides its sigma (2.0) and row 2 does not say 'entire stack'; provenance is still not complete in the list. Accidental display changes are recoverable only via Reset / Reset all.

reassessment.evidence: Gaussian Blur sheet on T1 head (10 slices): 'Apply to' now defaults to 'Current plane only' with the hint 'Only the plane shown now – choose “Entire stack” to process all 10 planes.' (16_gauss.png). Recorder: plane run -> scope='plane'; stack run -> no scope (API default = stack) (GET /api/recorder).
reassessment.comment: The cheaper, less surprising option is now the default; the recorder omitting scope for the stack run is consistent with the API default.

reassessment.evidence: Palette rows for Crop / Fit Ellipse / Make Inverse / Straighten / Rotate Selection with no selection show an amber 'needs an area selection (1, 2, 3, 4)' tag and disabled styling (aria-disabled=true) (18_pal_Crop.png). Enter gives 'Crop needs an area selection – draw a rectangle (1), oval (2), polygon (3) or freehand (4) selection first' (role=alert) – grammar fixed and next step named (19_err_*.png). aria-live regions are empty afterwards.
reassessment.comment: The toast still vanishes within seconds and several toasts stack when commands are fired repeatedly; the palette still lets Enter run a disabled-looking row.

reassessment.evidence: ROI Manager and Results have a 'This image only' checkbox on by default. On T1 head: 'No ROIs of this image. 41 ROIs of other images are in the manager – untick "This image only" to list them.' and 'No rows of this image. 41 rows of other images…' (15_t1head.png). ROIs are named 'Particle 1 (x 315, y 25)' with type column, Results Label column carries 'synthetic_cells.tif:1' (14_roi_results.png).
reassessment.comment: Results table in the 300 px inspector still truncates the numeric columns (Area, M…) – the pop-out arrow is needed to read it; the manager's tally is still global (0 / 41).

reassessment.evidence: Threshold state is per image: after Analyze/auto-threshold on synthetic_cells (thresholds keyed by image id), a new image (T1 head, Untitled) and the split-view compare pane show no overlay (23_split.png). On reload the overlay returns only for the image it was set on (22_thr_reload.png), with a visible badge 'threshold 1395–65535' and a header chip '1395–65535' on the Threshold section; pane compare shows no leaked red. Light theme: the badge is a dark chip with pink text (computed colour rgb(248,113,113) on rgba(13,15,20,.78), ~7:1) (24_light.png).
reassessment.comment: The overlay can still only be removed from the 'Clear' button inside the Threshold section (the viewport badge is not clickable).

reassessment.evidence: Tracks wizard on a 128x128x20 noise movie, 'Detect spots' -> '0 spots in 0 frames (quality ≥ 2.193e+04)'; step 1 chip now shows a '!' instead of a check; Next is disabled with title 'Detect spots first (a run with 0 spots does not count)' and the warning 'Detect spots first (a run with 0 spots does not count)' (29_wizard_detect.png). Spot radius shows '2.5' (decimal point).
reassessment.comment: The numbered step chips can still be clicked to jump straight to later steps (e.g. 6 Display, 30_wizard_jump.png) although Next is gated.

reassessment.evidence: Preferences: Selection stroke '1.5' and Tracks wizard Spot radius '2.5' now use a decimal point with navigator.language en-US (31_prefs.png, 28_wizard1.png).
reassessment.comment: Only these two places were re-checked.

reassessment.evidence: Clicked the viewport, pressed '[': focus moves to the 'Python code' textarea in the Script panel (32_bracket.png). Escape now returns focus to the canvas (document.activeElement = canvas-wrap) and Shift+K then opened the colour picker without typing into the script (editor text unchanged: 'img = lumen.image…'; 33_after_shiftk.png). The language select now shows 'Python' in full; the help overlay lists 'Leave the script editor – Esc' (36_help.png).

DOM audit (e9_s24): 0 interactive elements without an accessible name (was 5); Slices/Frames inputs have aria-labels; channel-name inputs have aria-labels. Tool rail has roving tabindex (2 tab stops among 23 buttons) and ArrowDown/End move through tools (Select -> Pan -> Rectangle -> Measure Distance Tool). Tab-close buttons are 24x24. Menubar trigger contrast 7.16:1 (was 4.43:1).
reassessment.comment: 24 of 80 interactive elements are still under 24 px (channel chips 17-19 px high, plugin tool buttons 34x17, threshold buttons 21 px, 13 px 'dark bg' checkbox, 14 px threshold handles).

reassessment.evidence: F10 focuses File; Down opens it; first Esc closes the menu and leaves focus on the trigger; second Esc returns focus to the canvas (document.activeElement = canvas-wrap) (e9_s36 output; help lists 'Menu bar F10 / ⌥ tap'). Type-ahead exists: in the Image menu typing 'Lo' moves focus to a menuitem (it landed on Overlay).
reassessment.comment: Type-ahead appears to cycle by first letter rather than buffer a prefix ('Lo' did not land on Lookup Tables).

reassessment.evidence: New Image sheet now states 'Size: 0 MB in memory (0.00% of 24.0 GB RAM)'; with 20000x20000 32-bit it turns amber: 'Size: 1.5 GB in memory (6% of 24.0 GB RAM) – large: a confirmation follows, and every undo step costs the same again' (26_newimage_big.png). Apply opens an alertdialog 'Create a 1.5 GB image?' with Cancel / 'Create 1.5 GB image' (27_bigconfirm.png); I cancelled, no image was created. Slices and Frames have '≥ 1' hints.
reassessment.comment: Slices/Frames still have no sliders (only a hint).

reassessment.evidence: Welcome screen on an empty session has 'Open file…', three sample buttons and 'Press ⌘K to search all 499 commands' (02_empty.png). Workflows section now has a chooser and cards with step counts and 'Requires: needs a time series / two or more channels' (38_workflows.png). The help overlay documents Esc from the editor. 3-D view (MIP/Alpha/Iso/Mesh, Spin, Snapshot) works and has sub-sections (39_3d.png).
reassessment.comment: Still 13 collapsible sections on a stack and Workflows is collapsed by default; the help overlay is 826 px tall at top 108 px so its last ~36 px lie below a 900 px window (36_help.png); the cube toggle in the 3-D view is still icon-only.

reassessment.evidence: At 900x650 and 760x600: no horizontal page scroll (scrollWidth == innerWidth), the image is re-fitted (179% in view), the inspector is a normal half-width panel (40_narrow900.png, 41_narrow760.png).
reassessment.comment: At narrow widths the theme / Preferences / Help icons are dropped from the top bar (still reachable with ⌘, and ?) and the bottom of the tool rail is cut off (E9-3).

new_problems.heuristic: Error prevention / Aesthetic and minimalist design
new_problems.location: Display section, channel min/max validation message
new_problems.observation: The new inline messages ('must be above the min…', 'must be below the maximum (1785)') are drawn into the same row: the text is clipped by the row below and the Auto / Reset / Inv buttons and the max box shift right to the inspector edge while the error is shown.

new_problems.location: Analyze Particles run with 'Auto-threshold and run' on a multichannel composite; Results row label
new_problems.observation: The run is performed on channel 1 (DAPI, hidden in the composite) – recorded only as channel=1 – but neither the '41 particles' toast, the sheet nor the Results label ('synthetic_cells.tif:1', 'synthetic_cells.tif' for a rectangle Measure) names the channel; only the Threshold panel does.

new_problems.location: Top bar and tool rail at 900x650
new_problems.observation: Instead of clipping, the theme, Preferences and Help icons are dropped from the top bar and the tool rail is cut off after the Fill tool (Text/Arrow/zoom/pipette not visible without scrolling).

new_problems.location: Command palette ranking for multi-word / misspelt queries
new_problems.observation: 'threshhold' puts 'Apply Threshold → Mask' above Threshold; 'fiji lut ice' returns only the two web-search rows although 'LUT: Ice' exists (extra words are not ignored).

Next is correctly gated after a 0-spot detection, but the numbered chips 2-7 are still clickable and open later steps (e.g. step 6 Display, step 4 Linker) without any prerequisite warning on the chip.

positives: Palette now carries state hints: rows that need a selection show 'needs an area selection (1, 2, 3, 4)' and disabled styling before the user presses Enter; typos (clahee, gausian) are tolerated and LUT names are first-class commands ('LUT: Fire').
Analyze Particles on an unthresholded image gives a persistent inline error with a one-click 'Auto-threshold and run' and 'Open the Threshold panel' – the exact recovery a trainee needs.
The Threshold section names the channel being thresholded and warns, with a 'Show channel 1' button, when that channel is hidden in the composite.
ROI Manager and Results default to 'This image only' with explicit counts of hidden rows from other images, descriptive ROI names and image-prefixed result labels.
Size estimate in New Image plus a confirmation dialog ('Create a 1.5 GB image?') for large allocations; Clear ROIs / Clear Results ask first and offer Undo clear.
Recorder now captures display edits, channel visibility, image selection and ROI-bearing measure calls with the image named, and exports Python / JavaScript / IJM.
Esc leaves the script editor and the menubar; the tool rail has roving tabindex and arrow-key navigation; all interactive controls have accessible names; menubar contrast is 7:1.

Modified-image close dialog (alertdialog, aria-modal, default focus Cancel, 'Close without saving' last) still works; history shows parameters; Gaussian preview with safe 'Current plane only' default.
No horizontal scroll and the image re-fits at 900 and 760 px widths.
overall: I would now let a trainee follow a Fiji recipe for LUTs, threshold + Analyze Particles, measure and Gaussian blur without standing next to them: the LUT names are where Fiji users look, the destructive 'Apply Display Range' commands are labelled as such, errors tell the trainee what to do, and ROI/Results no longer bleed across images. What still keeps it from being fully hands-off is traceability and accessibility polish: display edits are still not undoable and not in History, History hides default-valued parameters, the recorder is still one global log, 24 controls are below 24 px, and a few layout rough edges remain (min/max error overlap, help overlay clipped at 900 px, narrow-window icons dropped).
note: Re-evaluation of E5's findings on the build after fix round 3 (8 Nov 2026) by a separate agent of the same model family and persona, without access to the fix list; screenshots are not committed.
